title: Hostelworld reviews
description: One row per hostel guest review (charged), plus a free hostel context row and a free status row per target.

target.description: The input value (URL or property id) this row came from

property_id.description: Hostelworld's numeric property id (the number in /hostels/p/<id>/)

property_name.description: Hostel name as Hostelworld lists it

text.description: The review text (Hostelworld's notes field); null when the guest scored without writing

language.description: Language code of the text Hostelworld serves (always en today)

machine_translated.description: true when Hostelworld machine-translated the review into the served language

rating.description: Overall score on Hostelworld's 0-100 scale (100 = perfect); on property rows, the hostel's aggregate score

rating_5.description: The same score converted to the 0-5 star scale, e.g. 94 -> 4.7

sub_ratings.description: The seven 0-100 sub-scores: value, safety, location, staff, atmosphere, cleanliness, facilities

liked.description: What the guest liked, when Hostelworld splits the review that way (legacy field, usually null)

disliked.description: What the guest disliked, when Hostelworld splits the review that way (legacy field, usually null)

recommended.description: Whether the guest recommends the hostel (legacy field, usually null)

owner_comment.description: The hostel's public reply to the review, if any

group_type.description: MALE | FEMALE (solo travellers) | COUPLE | ALLFEMALEGROUP | ALLMALEGROUP | MIXEDGROUP | FAMILY

trip_types.description: Why they were travelling: REGULARVACATION, WEEKENDAWAY, GAPYEAR, RTWTRIP, COLLEGEBREAK, OTHER

reviewer_nickname.description: Reviewer display name ("Anonymous" when they hid it)

reviewer_gender.description: Male | Female when the reviewer published it

reviewer_reviews.description: How many reviews this guest has written on Hostelworld

reviewer_image.description: Reviewer avatar URL, when there is one

property_type.description: HOSTEL | GUESTHOUSE | HOTEL | APARTMENT | CAMPSITE (property rows)

star_rating.description: Star rating where the property has one, else 0 (property rows)

region.description: Region or district Hostelworld files the property under (property rows)

total_ratings.description: How many guests have rated the hostel in total, scores without text included (property rows)

currency.description: Currency the hostel prices in (property rows)

lowest_price_per_night.description: Hostelworld's lowest advertised nightly price (property rows)

best_for.description: What Hostelworld says the hostel is best for, e.g. ["Home Cooking", "Meeting People"] (property rows)

facilities.description: Every facility Hostelworld lists for the hostel (property rows)

description.description: Hostelworld's own write-up of the hostel, else the hostel's description (property rows)

positive_count.description: Reviews Hostelworld counts as positive (property rows)

negative_count.description: Reviews Hostelworld counts as negative (property rows)

solo_percentage.description: Share of reviewers travelling solo (property rows)

couples_percentage.description: Share of reviewers travelling as a couple (property rows)

groups_percentage.description: Share of reviewers travelling in a group (property rows)

reviews_listed.description: Reviews Hostelworld lists for the hostel (property rows)

reviews_fetched.description: Reviews read in this run for the hostel before filters (property rows)

status.description: ok | no_reviews | not_found | duplicate | error (status rows)

reviews.description: Reviews delivered and charged for this target (status rows)

filtered.description: Reviews dropped by the filters, never charged (status rows)

total.description: Reviews Hostelworld lists for the hostel (status rows)

duplicates.description: 1 when this target resolved to a hostel another target already covers (status rows)
